positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed various libraries and tools as part of a cloud scale tile based simulation engine. (C++) 
Helped develop VR demo to showcase engine capabilities (OpenVR)
Wrote a vulkan renderer as well as various shaders ( hlsl ) in support of demo
Created heightfield terrain with custom shaders and dynamic directional lighting updates triggered by terrain edits
Created a multi-threaded resource compiler tool to convert metadata and  various files types ( model, image, text ) into proprietary compressed format ( using LZ4 )
Built custom, cross platform cluster tool for managing remote worker nodes and processes
Worked on mesh simplification tool using unsigned distance field and ray tracing. (C++)
Developed cross platform ( win/linux ) filesystem wrapper with directory scanning (C++)
Implemented other helper classes including command line parser, perf monitor and pooled memory allocator (C++)

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Client work on HBO GO and HBO NOW

positions.title: Lead iOS Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed reusable, modular code framework used in Minnie’s Food Truck and Daniel Tiger’s Grrrific Feelings (iOS, Android, C#, Java, Objective-C, Unity3D)
•	Lead programmer on Daniel Tiger’s Day and Night, the #2 paid app on iTunes store as of August 30th, 2013 (iOS, Android) (Lua, Corona)
•	Developed navigable world map scene featuring path finding and flow fields (current effects) for National Geographic’s Marine Missions iPad App. (Lua, Corona)
•	Lead programmer on Bubble Guppies: Animal School Day.  (#2 paid iPad app as of Nov 5, 2012)(Objective-C, cocos2d)
•	Localized and expanded Nickelodeon Draw and Play app. (Objective-C,cocos-2d)

positions.title: Lead Programmer / Director
positions.description:
Overhauled Scene-It? iOS engine introducing logical OO class hierarchies and greatly reduced memory overhead.
 Code has been used in 16 released games available on the App Store.
 Converted the iOS trivia pack purchasing system from unlockable locally bundled content to a thin client model relying on downloadable remotely hosted data.
 Programmed proof of concept demos for various platforms.
 Developed various workflow tools to improve DVD and iOS development.
 Lead author on several Scene-It? DVD games and other titles including Disney Princess, Blast and Scene it? Travel Edition.
 Promoted to lead programmer; supervised a diverse team that included DVD authors, mobile and web programmers and the QA department.

positions.title: Programmer, Senior Programmer
positions.description:
Primary programmer of proprietary, cross-platform GUI library used in Magic the Gathering: Online, Bicycle Casino for Xbox and other unreleased titles.
 Took over writing 'log in' server (TCP/IP) that handled thousands of connections. Features included circular packet queues for reconnection and load balancing.
 Responsible for developing draft portion of Magic, including server-side rules enforcement, networking and front-end UI.
 Wrote editor, AI and GUI code for unreleased RTS game, Time Strike.
 Handled Xbox live! leaderboards, matchmaking, etc., for Bicycle Casino.
 Coded video poker and blackjack mini games for Bicycle Casino.
 Ensured Bicycle Casino complied with Microsoft TCR’s and shipped on time.
